findings.evidence: IndexInfo JSON tag for the predicate is now `condition_expr_string` in `pkg/meta/model/index.go:216` (was `partial_condition_expr_string` in the first parent). DDL job arg tag for the predicate is now `condition_string` in `pkg/meta/model/job_args.go:1374` (was `partial_condition_str` in the first parent). TableInfo is persisted/loaded via `encoding/json` in `pkg/meta/meta.go:737` and `pkg/meta/meta.go:1063`, so tag name changes directly affect on-disk schema decoding. There is no compatibility shim (no `UnmarshalJSON`, no alias field); `git grep partial_condition_expr_string` and `git grep partial_condition_str` return no matches on this commit and on `upstream/master`.
findings.fix: Keep the original JSON tags for stable storage format, or add backward-compatible decoding: implement `UnmarshalJSON` (or a versioned wrapper) for `model.IndexInfo` and `model.IndexArg` to accept both old and new keys and marshal to a single canonical key. If upgrade compatibility is intended, also populate `IndexInfo.AffectColumn` for pre-existing partial indexes on load (or compute it lazily) so DML/DDL checks behave consistently.
findings.impact: Mixed-version rolling upgrade (or upgrading from builds that wrote the old keys) can silently drop the partial-index predicate from metadata/job args. That can cause nodes to disagree on whether an index is partial vs normal, change `SHOW CREATE TABLE` output, break DDL job resume semantics, and in the worst case produce wrong results/constraint behavior if an older node treats a physically-partial index as a full index.
findings.later_fix_evidence: No fix found up to `upstream/master`: the old key strings don’t exist anywhere in `upstream/master`, implying no decode shim was added.
findings.verify: 1) Create a table with a partial index on a binary at the first parent, persist schema to meta, restart on this commit, and confirm the predicate is preserved and enforced. 2) Reverse direction: create on this commit and restart on the first-parent binary; ensure the old binary either rejects the schema or preserves correctness. 3) Simulate rolling upgrade where an old node plans/executes queries against a partial index created by a new node.
findings.what: Backward-incompatible metadata/DDL-job JSON key rename for partial index condition: `IndexInfo.ConditionExprString` and `IndexArg.ConditionString` changed tag names without a decode shim, so upgrades or mixed-version clusters can silently lose the partial-index predicate.
